Maya: Quick question from the all-hands Q&A: when exactly do managers need to submit promotion packets?

People Ops: Hey Maya 013 managers should submit by Apr 3. Calibration is Apr 6Apr 12 and manager-facing outcomes go out Apr 18.

Derek: If a packet lands late because of PTO, is there any exception?

People Ops: Small grace window to Apr 5 if you notify your People Partner. Anything later needs ELT approval.

Priya: For internal transfers, do we apply full band moves or prorated comp?

People Ops: Level changes typically get a band move; the comp increase amount depends on market gap and budget. We sometimes phase increases (rare).

HR-bot: Reminder: Promo packet deadline in 11 days (Apr 3) 013 upload to /hr/promotions.

Maya: Can we get a short office hours session to review example packets?

People Ops: Yes 013 hosting two sessions next week, calendar invite going out. Will attach sample packets.

Derek: Thanks B50

People Ops: Posting the refreshed checklist in the doc now: https://redwood.internal/docs/promotions
